summary: Phase 7 — Featured Artists arc (iter39 + iter40 + iter41) full validation: monthly pipeline + statement-position lock + 5-option statement composer + Foundation Prospects + Explore-before-Embrace public invite flow. Backend 28/28 PASS (10.9s) via pytest across the three iter files. Frontend critical paths VERIFIED end-to-end against REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL: (1) Admin POST /api/gallery/admin/prospects + /promote returns a preview_url at /gallery/invite/{token}. (2) Public preview at that URL renders fully WITHOUT login — site header, FEATURED ARTIST INVITATION label, editorial reason quote, intended-month text, no-commitment explainer banner, live preview hero with FOUNDATION PICK badge, all 5 statement composer buttons (data-testid=statement-option-{freeform,ai_summary,nomination_quote,own_statement,blank}), statement textarea, all 4 layout-option buttons, all 6 accent-option color swatches, all 5 position-preview buttons (tl/tr/bl/br/cb), the What enrolling means panel (testid=what-acceptance-means) showing You Agree To / You Keep / Foundation share, and Accept/Decline action buttons. (3) Clicking Accept reveals the One-last-step form with accept-password-input + accept-terms-checkbox + accept-confirm-btn. Submitting with password+terms triggers POST /invite/{token}/accept which atomically creates user+partner_profile(source=foundation)+featured_slot(source=foundation)+session_token — redirects to home with green sonner toast 'Welcome — you're enrolled as a Birthright Featured Artist'. (4) /admin/gallery/prospects renders list with status-filter chips, search box, the Log-a-new-prospect button (data-testid=add-prospect-btn) opens the create-prospect-form with create-prospect-submit. The naming convention from the request is honored. Per-iter40: statement_position is cycled across the 5-position set and locked on first active read (test_statement_position_locked_on_first_active_view + test_adjacent_slots_get_different_positions both pass). Per-iter41: prospect → interaction → auto-advance-to-responded_interested → promote → public preview → accept all green; non-admin blocked; re-accept blocked.

issues: statement-option testid is singular 'nomination_quote' while request docstring said 'statement-option-freeform etc' which could imply pluralization — naming is consistent with the BackendOptionsResponse (option key matches), so this is not a bug. Just noting for future testers that the testid IS 'nomination_quote' (singular).

The list rows do not currently have data-testid='prospect-card' on each row, and the per-row Log-interaction / Promote actions (rendered after clicking a row) do not have explicit data-testid attributes like 'promote-prospect-btn'/'log-interaction-btn'. The request only required add-prospect-btn / create-prospect-form / create-prospect-submit — all three present. Add the row-level testids if future tests want to click into a specific prospect.

action_items: (optional, low priority) Add data-testid='prospect-card' to each row in AdminGalleryProspects.jsx and 'promote-prospect-btn' / 'log-interaction-btn' inside the row-detail panel for finer-grained testability. Not blocking — current testids satisfy the request.
critical_code_review_comments: Iter40 STATEMENT_POSITIONS cycle of 5 (tl/tr/bl/br/cb) is correctly applied via _statement_position_for_index — adjacent indices differ by construction. The lock-on-first-active-read pattern (set + persist statement_position_locked_at, never overwrite) is correctly implemented and verified by test_statement_position_locked_on_first_active_view. Good.

Iter41 promote endpoint correctly requires contact_email + editorial_reason on Foundation months, generates an invite token, and the public /gallery/invite/{token} endpoint never requires auth — the preview_count increment and status transition (sent → previewed → accepted/declined) all verified by tests + manual E2E. Atomic enrollment on Accept (user + partner_profile + featured_slot + gallery_space + JWT) cleanly returns session_token so the SPA auto-signs-in the new user — observed in the live test.
180-char signature_statement ceiling enforced server-side (422 at 181, 200 at exactly 180) and surfaced in /statement-options as max_length=180. Good defense.

Public invite page (FeaturedInvite.jsx) properly hides the password+terms form behind the Accept button (progressive disclosure) — explore-before-embrace UX intent is preserved. The toast on success is a nice closure cue.
Email is in EMAIL_DRY_RUN=true mode by design — outbound_emails queue is the testing surface. No real email sent during this iter; matches mocked_apis_list.
